subjectQuote:
PITKIN COUNTY BALLOT ISSUE 1A:
HEALTHY COMMUNITY FUND MILL LEVY

whatItDoes:
SHALL PITKIN COUNTY TAXES BE INCREASED BY $5,266,081.00 ANNUALLY, BEGINNING
IN THE FIRST FULL FISCAL YEAR OF COLLECTION IN 2028, TO CONTINUE FUNDING THE
HEALTHY COMMUNITY FUND, WHICH HAS PROVIDED FUNDING FOR HEALTH AND HUMAN
SERVICES AND COMMUNITY NON-PROFITS FOR THE PAST TWENTY-FOUR YEARS, AFTER THE
CURRENT PROPERTY TAX EXPIRES IN 2027, AND BY SUCH ADDITIONAL AMOUNTS AS ARE
GENERATED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER FOR A PERIOD NOT TO EXCEED TWENTY FIVE YEARS,
BY THE IMPOSITION OF A NEW 0.853 MILL LEVY, FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF PROVIDING A
STABLE FUNDING SOURCE FOR HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES AND COMMUNITY NON-PROFITS
INCLUDING:
• PROTECTIVE AND SUPPORTIVE SERVICES, INCLUDING FOOD ACCESS, FOR CHILDREN AND
ADULTS
• SERVICES AND ACTIVITIES SUPPORTING HEALTHY AGING FOR OLDER ADULTS
• SUPPORTING SURVIVORS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE AND SEXUAL ASSAULT
• BEHAVIORAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE USE PREVENTION, TREATMENT, AND AFTERCARE 		
SERVICES
• CARE FOR THE TERMINALLY ILL AND THEIR FAMILIES
• PROTECTING AND SUPPORTING NATURAL RESOURCES
• PREVENTIVE AND INTEGRATED HEALTH CARE SERVICES FOR LOWER-INCOME INDIVIDUALS
• SERVICES SUPPORTING INDEPENDENCE FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL 		
DISABILITIES AND THEIR FAMILIES
AND SHALL THE COUNTY BE AUTHORIZED TO COLLECT, RETAIN, AND SPEND ALL REVENUES
FROM SUCH TAX AND THE INTEREST EARNINGS THEREON AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE
CHANGE ABOVE THE ANNUAL LIMITS OF ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO
CONSTITUTION AND ABOVE ANNUAL LIMITS WHICH MIGHT OTHERWISE APPLY OR BE
PROPOSED, INCLUDING AS AN APPROVED EXCEPTION TO THE LIMITATIONS SET FORTH IN
SECTION 29-1-301 OF THE COLORADO REVISED STATUTES OR ARTICLE 9 OF THE COUNTY HOME
RULE CHARTER?

subjectQuote:
CITY OF ASPEN BALLOT ISSUE 2A:
DEBT FOR WATER TREATMENT FACILITY PROJECT

whatItDoes:
WITHOUT INCREASING ANY TAXES, SHALL THE CITY OF ASPEN DEBT BE INCREASED BY
AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $100,000,000, WITH A TOTAL REPAYMENT COST NOT TO
EXCEED $255,000,000, FOR THE PURPOSE OF FINANCING THE EXPANSION, RENOVATION,
IMPROVEMENT, REMODELING AND EQUIPPING OF ITS WATER TREATMENT FACILITY; SUCH
DEBT TO BE ISSUED IN THE FORM OF REVENUE BONDS OR OTHER MULTIPLE FISCAL YEAR
FINANCIAL OBLIGATION, WITH SUCH TERMS, AND BEARING INTEREST AT SUCH RATES AS MAY
BE APPROVED BY CITY COUNCIL, PAYABLE SOLELY FROM THE WATER ACTIVITY ENTERPRISE
REVENUE, AND TO COLLECT, RETAIN AND SPEND ALL REVENUE AND INTEREST FROM THESE
FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE TO LIMITS UNDER
COLORADO LAW, OR ANY OTHER LAW?

subjectQuote:
SNOWMASS WATER AND SANITATION DISTRICT
BALLOT ISSUE 6A:

whatItDoes:
SHALL SNOWMASS WATER AND SANITATION DISTRICT DEBT BE INCREASED UP TO $15 MILLION,
WITH A MAXIMUM REPAYMENT COST OF NOT MORE THAN $22.5 MILLION, AND SHALL DISTRICT
TAXES BE INCREASED UP TO $2 MILLION ANNUALLY FOR THE PURPOSE OF FINANCING THE
EXPANSION OF ZIEGLER RESERVOIR, TO INCREASE MUNICIPAL WATER SUPPLY, IMPROVE RAW
WATER QUALITY AND PROVIDE ADDITIONAL WATER FOR EMERGENCY FIRE SUPPRESSION, AND
TO THE EXTENT OF AVAILABLE FUNDS FINANCING SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS, SUCH DEBT TO
CONSIST OF THE ISSUANCE AND PAYMENT OF GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, WHICH BONDS
SHALL BEAR INTEREST AT A MAXIMUM NET EFFECTIVE INTEREST RATE NOT TO EXCEED FIVE
AND ONE-HALF PERCENT PER ANNUM AND BE ISSUED AT SUCH TIMES AND PRICES (AT, ABOVE
OR BELOW PAR) AND IN SUCH MANNER AND CONTAINING SUCH TERMS, NOT INCONSISTENT
HEREWITH, AS THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS MAY DETERMINE; AND SHALL AD VALOREM
PROPERTY TAXES BE LEVIED WITHOUT LIMIT AS TO THE MILL RATE TO GENERATE AMOUNTS,
NOT TO EXCEED THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH ABOVE, SUFFICIENT IN EACH YEAR TO PAY THE
PRINCIPAL OF, PREMIUM IF ANY, AND INTEREST ON SUCH DEBT?

subjectQuote:
SNOWMASS-WILDCAT FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT
BALLOT ISSUE 6B:

whatItDoes:
SHALL SNOWMASS-WILDCAT FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT TAXES BE INCREASED $2,300,000
MILLION IN THE FIRST FULL FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JANUARY 1, 2027 AND BY SUCH AMOUNT
AS ARE RAISED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER BY A SALES TAX OF 0.55% (55 CENTS ON EACH $100)
UPON EVERY TRANSACTION IN THE DISTRICT IN WHICH THE STATE IMPOSES A SALES TAX
(EXCLUDING GROCERIES AND OTHER EXEMPT ITEMS) FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROVIDING FIRE
PROTECTION AND EMERGENCY SERVICES AS SERVICE DEMANDS INCREASE, INCLUDING BUT
NOT LIMITED TO:
• ESTABLISHMENT, OPERATION, AND MAINTENANCE OF A YEAR-ROUND WILDLAND FIRE 		
DIVISION

RESCUE, AND EMERGENCY RESPONSE CAPABILITIES

IMPROVEMENT COSTS;

ANY REVENUE LIMITS PROVIDED BY LAW?
